[[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas|PFP]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Lanao del Norte's 1st congressional district''' is a [[congressional districts of the Philippines|congressional district]] in the province of [[Lanao del Norte]] that has been used in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 5, 2021}} The district's boundaries have been redrawn twice, originally consisting of seven municipalities and one city lining the coast of [[Iligan Bay]] in 1987, then losing the highly urbanized city of [[Iligan]] to its own separate district in October 2009, and finally with eleven municipalities including its capital, [[Tubod, Lanao del Norte|Tubod]], since the second reapportionment in November 2009.{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=March 5, 2021}}{{cite web|url=https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9724_2009.html |title=Republic Act No. 9724 |publisher=Arellano Law Foundation |accessdate=March 5, 2021}}{{cite web|url=https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9774_2009.html |title=Republic Act No. 9774 |publisher=Arellano Law Foundation |accessdate=March 5, 2021}} The district is represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Imelda Dimaporo]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members
